metadata.purpose: TBL-006 forward-collision register: every migration after the timetable foundation baseline that touches a baseline-owned timetable object.
metadata.baseline_note: Baseline is live-only (per TIMETABLE_FIX_REGISTER.md TBL-004 closure and migration_classification.json). No repository SQL body exists for it, so baseline-owned objects were identified by exclusion: any table referenced or altered by post-baseline migrations with no CREATE TABLE statement anywhere in the repository migration set is treated as baseline-owned.
metadata.excluded_object_note: schools/classes/subjects are cross-cutting core tables used far outside the timetable domain and are not treated as timetable-baseline-owned for this register. They are candidates for a separate 'core schema' collision register if needed later, out of TBL-006 scope.
metadata.generated_by: TBL-006 repository-only static analysis (no live Supabase connection available in this session; no git history available in this session — see limitations)
limitations: No .git directory was present in the analyzed snapshot, so this register was built from repository files only, not from commit history.

No live Supabase connection was available in this session. Entries below reflect repository file content only. Live schema state (pg_get_constraintdef, actual applied DDL) must be re-confirmed before this register is trusted as final.

Baseline SQL body does not exist in the repository, so the full baseline-owned object list cannot be enumerated with certainty; only objects with no in-repo CREATE TABLE were inferred as baseline-owned.

entries.operation: ADD CONSTRAINT excl_room_overlap (no DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS first)
entries.dependency: Directly collides with 20260717215951, which already created a constraint of the same name (excl_room_overlap) with an identical gist expression and identical WHERE clause one migration earlier.
entries.required_resolution: On a clean rebuild from blank state, this statement will raise 'constraint "excl_room_overlap" for relation "timetable_slots" already exists' because 20260717215951 already added a constraint with this exact name and definition. Add 'alter table public.timetable_slots drop constraint if exists excl_room_overlap;' immediately before this ADD CONSTRAINT, or remove this redundant block entirely if the two definitions are truly identical (they appear to be, aside from formatting).
entries.evidence: Direct text comparison: 20260717215951 lines 19-27 and 20260718054252 lines 9-19 both add a constraint named excl_room_overlap on public.timetable_slots with the same gist expression, WHERE (room is not null) clause, and column set (school_id, room, day_of_week, tsrange(...), daterange(effective_from, effective_until, '[]')).
